scientific_integrity: Proof by finite-dimensional transfer matrix, formal resolvent and residue asymptotics; standalone exact coefficient checks are supporting tests only.
scientific_limitations: Stationary annealed coordinate covariance; no general/quenched decay theorem. No uniqueness at a=1. Novelty constrained by inspected primary literature and searchable indexed records, not independently certified.
source_ids: Pérez Otero IPICYT thesis (2023), Chapter 4 Section 4.4
title: Exact coordinate correlations and a singular relaxation crossover in a random identity–doubling map
